title: Edit Line names its fields Title and Description and keeps the saved values
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin (all permissions) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QA build.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-A01 Fleet) has a contact person and an asset, {Asset-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-A01 Truck).
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is open for {Customer-A} and {Asset-A} at {Location-A}, not invoiced.
  • {Work-order-1} has a line {Line-1} with Title (for example Replace - Brake pot) and Description (for example pads at 2mm).
custom_steps:
1. Open {Work-order-1} and go to its Lines tab.
  2. Click {Line-1}'s title to open Edit Line.
  3. Read the first field's label and its value.
  4. Read the second field's label and its value.
  5. Clear the Description field.
  6. Read the second field's label and the grey text inside it.
  7. Clear the Title field.
  8. Read the first field's label and the grey text inside it.
  9. Close the window without saving.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: the first field is labeled "Title" and shows {Line-1}'s saved title exactly (for example Replace - Brake pot).
  • Step 4: the second field is labeled "Description" and shows the saved description exactly (for example pads at 2mm).
  • Step 6: the label still reads "Description" and the grey prompt "Why are you doing it?" shows in the empty box.
  • Step 8: the label still reads "Title" and the grey prompt "What are you doing?" shows in the empty box.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10130 (Story 1, The Work Order Line Dialog); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, S1-R1, S1-R2, S1-R3, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.5 (Edit Line - after) and 1.4 (Edit Line - before), 13 Oct copy; tech plan "Title and Description - Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 2026-09-23, shared by the QA lead 13 Oct 2026), FR-001, FR-002, FR-003; Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R1: “The first field is labeled exactly "Title".”
  • S1-R2: “The second field is labeled exactly "Description".”
  • S1-R3: “The Title box carries the placeholder "What are you doing?" and the Description box carries "Why are you doing it?". Placeholder text shows while the box is empty and disappears as soon as there is a value.”
  • SV-10130 acceptance criteria: “Given the Edit Line dialog is open on an existing line, then the same two labels are shown and the saved values appear unchanged.”
